title: Gotsman–Linial polynomial
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, define a real polynomial by $P_{n,k}(X)=\prod_{j=0}^{k-1}\bigl(X-r_{n,k}(j)\bigr)$, where $r_{n,k}(j)$ is the Gotsman–Linial root associated with $n$, $k$, and $j$.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define `gotsmanLinialRoot`, so its mathematical meaning cannot be specified beyond its role as the indexed root.
